protocol.name: Meteora DLMM
protocol.note: C59 account-list rebuild (2026-08-14): account lists rebuilt from the official DLMM IDL (tenequm/solana-idls idl/meteora-dlmm.json, codama writable/signer metadata); the prior build carried 2-account placeholders for most instructions. swap (f8c69e91e17587c8) verified position-for-position against a real mainnet transaction (2026-08-14, sig 2LvQMMWX2vQv..., 15 static accounts + variable bin-array tail): 6 writable reserves/token accounts, 2 mints, oracle, signer user, both token programs, event authority, program. swap_exact_out shares the identical layout (only the data args differ). 7 instructions absent from the current IDL surface (initialize_pool, initialize_pool_with_custom_curve, add_pool_fee, remove_pool_fee, remove_liquidity_by_strategy, claim_all_reward, add_liquidity_single_side) keep their prior lists.

instructions.name: swap
expected_state_changes: swaps tokens using active bin arrays
debits user_token_in
credits user_token_out
updates reserve_x and reserve_y
risk_rules: RISK: verify output amount matches expected within slippage tolerance
RISK: verify lb_pair is legitimate and not a honeypot

instructions.name: addLiquidity
expected_state_changes: deposits liquidity across price bin range
debits user_token_x and user_token_y
credits reserve_x and reserve_y
risk_rules: sender must be signer and own the position
RISK: verify lb_pair and bin arrays are legitimate
